target: Searchable command-style project picker in the product header

library.primary: existing shadcn semantic tokens and Radix Dialog

contract.purpose: App Health helps product teams understand web traffic, intentional user actions, and application health across their projects.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md and the existing App Health Site Health purpose contract, reviewed 2026-09-23.
contract.canonicalPurpose: App Health helps product teams understand web traffic, intentional user actions, and application health across their projects.
contract.audience: Founders and product teams operating a portfolio of applications.
contract.job: Find and switch to one authorized project quickly from a 20-plus-project portfolio while retaining environment context.
contract.thesis: A compact command finder keeps the existing calm App Health header and makes project discovery search-first.
contract.system: Use the existing graphite/light shadcn palette, semantic foreground and muted tokens, a single bordered dialog, restrained section labels, 44px touch targets, visible focus rings, and a scroll-bounded result list. Dark and light modes inherit the shell tokens.
contract.signature: Pin All projects above session-recent and alphabetized project results, so the entire portfolio stays one keystroke away.
contract.risk: Recents introduce transient client state; store IDs only for this session and intersect them with the currently authorized inventory before display.
